scope: Retry only EAGAIN immediately, at most5 syscalls per initial/logging phase, preserving first condition/all attempted failure errnos and successful FD ownership. No userspace delay, permanent-error retry loop or change to retained-pipeline verification/GC gating.
bounds: Default at most10 total BPF_PROG_LOAD syscalls per program if both phases exhaust. Public per-phase budget1..16; invalid budgets fail before a syscall. Non-EAGAIN ends its phase immediately and does not consume the remaining EAGAIN allowance. The existing eight-endpoint preparation budget is unchanged; each preparation includes several separately bounded program loads.
testCoverage: Initial/logging EAGAIN-then-success, both-phase exhaustion, intervening permanent failures including EACCES subtype preservation, complete errno history, budget validation, previous loader checks and Networking/Service/CNI/NetworkPolicy/retained GC gating. Integrated gate adds Raft after upstream WAL framing changes.

native.environment: Disposable Fedora44 VM22291; two actual native containerd agents over VXLAN, one control plane, no debug server. Private leases provisioned/withdrawn offline; no packet source-NAT claim. Native source predates unrelated upstream WAL framing integration; the combined-source unit gate is separate.

kernelProbe.scope: Six real-kernel probe checks. Two explicitly inject EAGAIN at the syscall boundary: a successful retry returns an actual kernel program FD that closes, and a logging retry preserves real verifier EACCES with13/11/13 history. Four prior checks cover valid FD lifecycle and actual invalid-program EACCES/ENOSPC logs. The injected EAGAIN is distinct from the natural agent0 recovery.
